title: Truth or Dare
description: Pick truth or dare on your turn. Keep it playful and kind.

cards.text: What's the most embarrassing thing you've done in public?
What's a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
What's the last thing you searched on your phone?
What's a talent you have that most people don't know about?
Who in this room would you trust to plan your birthday?
What's the worst haircut you've ever had?
What's a movie you can quote almost entirely?
What's your most irrational fear?
What's the strangest food combination you actually enjoy?
What's something you're secretly proud of?
What's the last thing that made you laugh out loud?
If you could instantly master one skill, what would it be?
What's a habit you'd love to break?
What's the best gift you've ever received?
What's a song you're a little embarrassed to love?
What's the most spontaneous thing you've ever done?
Speak in an accent until your next turn.
Do your best impression of someone in the room.
Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to.
Do 10 jumping jacks right now.
Let the group pick your profile picture pose — strike it.
Talk without using the letter 'S' until your next turn.
Do your best runway walk across the room.
Tell a joke — if no one laughs, tell another.
Balance something on your head for 30 seconds.
Do your best robot dance for 15 seconds.
Say the alphabet backwards as fast as you can.
Give a dramatic movie-trailer voiceover of your day.
Compliment every person in the room.
Pose like a statue until someone makes you laugh.
Do your best celebrity impression and let others guess.
Hum a tune and let the group guess the song.
